additional_info.subject: ID0476979-DC/Si-D/AT- [MP / S6 170003783] Fast-Shutdown Check Failed CRM:03289000486
additional_info.body:
Dear Laurenz,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Currently the charging station is working properly, as shown in the attached picture:
Following a review of the information provided, and a deeper system check, we can confirm that the issue has been resolved. Our analysis indicate that the fault was likely caused by a hard reboot of the charging station that took slightly longer than usual to complete its full sequence.
Specifically, the hard reboot was initiated at approximately 11.06, and the system returned to full operational status by 11.12:
For this reason, we observed the error you mentioned, as detailed in the attached logs:
And after the end of the hard reboot session, we don’t find the errors you reported again.
Please let us know if you have any further questions or concerns. If not, we will close the ticket within 48 hours
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
